user_story:
As a user, I want to manage my shopping cart so that I can view the items I intend to purchase and continue shopping or proceed to checkout.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The cart page should display the header 'Your Cart' using the selector [data-test="primary-header"].
- The cart should have a 'Continue Shopping' button that is visible using the selector [data-test="continue-shopping"].
- The cart should have a 'Checkout' button that is visible using the selector [data-test="checkout"].
